context: I am building a Web3 wallet analytics app for active traders. Users need to connect wallets, review token balances, inspect transactions across chains, compare network activity, and estimate gas fees.
goals: Help users understand wallet performance across networks.
Make transaction status and gas fee risk explicit.
Help users inspect transaction hashes without losing context.
businessGoals: Make complex blockchain data easier to scan.

referenceImages.label: wallet analytics reference
referenceImages.notes: Technical dashboard with wallet connection state, token cards, network badges, and transaction table.
